title: Sparring partners wanted. I have eternity and a spear

posts.title: Sparring partners wanted. I have eternity and a spear
posts.author: Achilles
posts.body:
The fields down here are wide, the shades are unmotivated, and I have not had a real fight in a very long time. If you are dead, immortal, or otherwise hard to break, meet me by the asphodel.

Mortals, please do not respond. I will feel bad.

posts.author: Ares
posts.body: ACCEPTED. Name the hour. Bring the spear. I will bring several.

posts.author: Ares
posts.body: The asphodel is not in your jurisdiction. I checked.

posts.author: Achilles
posts.body: I have fought beside him, against him, and near him, and in every case he was the least disciplined thing on the field. Yes. Tomorrow at dusk.

posts.author: Achilles
posts.body:
Update for the thread. He lost his temper inside the first minute, which is when I win against most people. I will not describe the rest out of courtesy, except to say that when he left he made the noise Homer describes — the one that sounds like ten thousand men shouting at once. It is accurate. The shades in the asphodel have not settled down since.

Recommended, with reservations.

posts.author: Athena
posts.body: I am aware the asphodel is not in my jurisdiction. The forum is. Thread stays open; the answer remains no.
